gaps.title: Canonical V9 cannot be reconstructed from the carrier in this repository
gaps.statement: CLAUDE_START_V9.md requires LOSSLESS_VERIFIED at SHA 8ad73f53...e55d. Seed part 16 is short 4,823 binary bytes of LZMA-compressed V7 content that exists in no git object.
gaps.whyItMatters: Every directive in canonical V9 is unreadable until this closes. The program is currently executed from its V7 ancestor, which is explicitly not the same document.
gaps.implementationPath: None. The missing bytes are compressed content, not a derivable checksum.
gaps.unblockCondition: The founder supplies the V7 or V9 file; part 16 is re-encoded from it and the materializer prints LOSSLESS_VERIFIED against the unmodified manifest.

gaps.authorityRequired: Founder. Ranking one canon file above another is a constitutional amendment (F003).
gaps.nextExperiment: None. Inventing an order would be legislating.
gaps.title: The precedence law cannot settle any conflict between operative rules
gaps.statement: docs/NORTH_STAR_PRECEDENCE.md ranks 10 files, of which exactly 1 is compiled as operative canon. The other 8 operative sources carry no relative rank.
gaps.whyItMatters: Nine conflict candidates are detected between operative rules and none has an authored answer, including a live one between the Wallbreaker prohibition on evading provider limits and the CLAUDE.md failover permission.
gaps.implementationPath: Already built: precedenceFor returns UNRANKED rather than 0, resolveByPrecedence refuses and names the source needing a rank.
gaps.unblockCondition: The founder ranks the operative canon in docs/NORTH_STAR_PRECEDENCE.md. The ranks are parsed from that file, so the conflict graph resolves with no code change.

gaps.externalEvidenceRequired: A fresh probe of the declared health ref by something with network authority.
gaps.authorityRequired: Network/deployment authority to call the live service. This session has no authority to probe an external host.
gaps.nextExperiment: A scheduled probe job, or one authorized manual probe piped into scripts/ubercel-record-health.mjs.
gaps.title: Deployment state rests on evidence that has expired
gaps.statement: A health contract is declared and one contract-bound probe is recorded, so Ubercel now reports UNKNOWN__EVIDENCE_STALE rather than UNKNOWN__ONLY_PROVIDER_BADGES. Establishing the present state needs a fresh probe.
gaps.whyItMatters: The difference between "we have no way to know" and "we knew, and the knowledge expired" is the whole point of this doctor. Only the second is a waiting problem.
gaps.implementationPath: Done. src/ubercel-health-evidence.mjs converts a probe into a contract-bound signal and scripts/ubercel-record-health.mjs writes it. Neither makes a network call, so running them cannot manufacture the evidence.
gaps.unblockCondition: Any authorized caller records a contract-bound probe younger than the doctor freshness window, after which the state becomes SERVING or NOT_SERVING.
sourceEvidence: a contract-bound probe exists and has aged out of the freshness window

gaps.title: External-effect directives with no mutation-killed guard behind them
gaps.statement: The constitution doctor reports external-effect rules the guard matcher cannot link to any mutation guard.
gaps.whyItMatters: An unguarded external-effect rule can be broken in code with every check green. Four genuine holes were found this way; the rest were measurement artifacts.
gaps.implementationPath: Read each reported directive, classify it, and close genuine holes with a test that fails when the protection is removed plus a guard that runs it.

gaps.title: Verified work sitting on a branch and not in main
gaps.statement: The completion law requires that no verified intended work is stranded off main.
gaps.whyItMatters: Work that exists only on a branch is work the next session will not find and may rebuild.
gaps.implementationPath: Merge or explicitly classify every branch carrying content not in main.

gaps.title: Artifacts that cannot be written until something outside the repository happens
gaps.statement: Eleven artifacts the contract names wait on external reality, repeated observation, elapsed unattended time, or a lattice runtime that does not exist.
gaps.whyItMatters: Writing them anyway would produce files describing nothing. A status report for a runtime that does not exist is the confusion the doctrine names, in file form.
gaps.implementationPath: None. Each names what it waits on in artifacts/v7/artifact-index.json.
gaps.unblockCondition: Each artifact unblocks when its own named condition is met. The index carries the reason per artifact and the gap closes when none is left waiting.
sourceEvidence: 11 contract artifacts wait on something no amount of writing produces

gaps.nextExperiment: Take the highest-value absent artifact next. Proof obligations and the claim-evidence registry sit earliest in the execution order.
gaps.closureEvidence: no absent contract artifact is computable now; 11 remain and each names what it waits on
gaps.title: Artifacts the V7 contract names that could be written and have not been
gaps.statement: The contract names 29 machine-readable artifacts. The index resolves each to GENERATED, COVERED_BY_EXISTING_ARTIFACT, or ABSENT, and the absent ones are unwritten software.
gaps.whyItMatters: Without this gap the ledger reads sourceSideComplete while nineteen named artifacts do not exist, which is exactly the false completion the contract forbids. An absent artifact is not a rounding error just because the ledger did not have a row for it.
gaps.implementationPath: Build each absent artifact where it would carry real measurement, or record a cover if existing source already holds the content. Empty files do not count: the index reads statSync, not intent.

uncertainty: A check measures what it reads. A CLOSED software gap means the check passed at this exact head, not that the underlying capability is externally proven.
